versions.subject: rule: Firewall disabled via Netsh
versions.detection:
selection:
  CommandLine:
  - netsh firewall set opmode mode=disable
  - netsh advfirewall set * state off
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("netsh firewall set opmode mode=disable", "netsh advfirewall set * state off")

versions.subject: feat: updates and enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'netsh.exe'
selection_cli_1:
    # Example: netsh firewall set opmode disable
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'firewall'
        - 'set'
        - 'opmode'
        - 'disable'
selection_cli_2:
    # Example: netsh advfirewall set currentprofile state off
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'advfirewall'
        - 'set'
        - 'state'
        - 'off'
condition: selection_img and 1 of selection_cli_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\netsh.exe" OR OriginalFileName="netsh.exe" (CommandLine="*firewall*" CommandLine="*set*" CommandLine="*opmode*" CommandLine="*disable*") OR (CommandLine="*advfirewall*" CommandLine="*set*" CommandLine="*state*" CommandLine="*off*")
